reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The rule's preferred position is 'no non-solicit on Customer'; the cited text (Section 14.10 integration clause and the Section 13.5/Developments personnel provisions) contains no solicitation, hiring, or inducement restriction on Corio (the licensee/customer), so absence of the covenant is the preferred outcome rather than a 'missing' gap.
Failed deterministic checks (duration not found, no general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause at all and do not indicate a defect here.

Rationale accurately characterizes the personnel-related provisions as NDA/invention-assignment and access obligations only, and confirms no non-solicit is incorporated by reference; no actionable edit is required.
